data.name: Hotel Panorama
data.address: Calle Platino 20, Valle Gómez, Cuauhtémoc, 06240 Ciudad de México, CDMX, Mexico
data.description:
An 11-minute walk from a metro station, this straightforward hotel on a city street lined with shops is also 3 km from both Zócalo square and the Basilica of Our Lady of Guadalupe.
The modestly decorated rooms come with free Wi-Fi, cable TV and desks. Upgraded rooms add in-room whirlpool tubs and/or living areas. There's no air-conditioning. Room service is available 24/7.
Secured parking is complimentary. Amenities include a 24-hour snack bar.
